# Hamza Ali (fzhamzaali)

> Hamza Ali, known online as fzhamzaali, is a tech entrepreneur, full-stack software developer and financial market practitioner from Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, India. He is the Founder & CEO of ZYVRAON (ZYVRAON®).

## About ZYVRAON
ZYVRAON is a software company based in Gorakhpur, India, founded and led by Hamza Ali. It began as a D2C audio brand and moved into software and ethical fintech.

## Products
- Halal Street (https://halalstreet.vercel.app/): an ethical fintech platform for Indian investors with Shariah-compliant stock screening, portfolio management and purification calculations.
- Zyvraon App Store (also called Hamza's Playstore): an Android app store where any developer can publish an app and users download APKs directly.
- Hamza's Music (also released as Rox Music): a Flutter music streaming app for Android. Any artist can upload their own original songs. Latest public build v2.1.150.
- Zyvraon Ad Network (Zyvraon Ads): ZYVRAON's own ad network. Anyone can run video and audio sponsor ads in ZYVRAON apps and partner apps. Launched in Hamza's Music v2.1.138 (October 2026).
